name: Hypothetical Syllogism (P→Q, Q→R ⊢ P→R)
description: Transitivity of implication — the chain rule for conditionals. Five legal moves splice two scrolls into one: iterate Q→R into the body of P→Q (IT+), deiterate the shared Q (IT-), peel the resulting double cut (DC-) to reach P→(Q∧R), erase the now-positive Q (ERA) to get P→R, and erase the spent second premise (ERA). The substantial derivation of the set — every step a real, attestable Dau-rule application.
